programme.desc: When Arthur and Martha find that their pension pot is virtually worthless they decide to take drastic action by robbing a bank! After their first robbery is successful they start to like the criminal lifestyle, but as the robberies get riskier will they be able to outwit the police as they close in?

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: The Book of Love
programme.desc: When Penny, the light of Henry's life, is killed in a car crash, he puts everything on hold as he tries to come to terms with his loss. When his bereavement leave is over, everyone expects straight-laced Henry to return to work. But now everything has changed and Henry is not going back.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Escaped convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) are on the run and out of money.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl. He eventually finds himself having to choose between his world and the world Penelope lives in.

programme.title: A Whirlwind Wedding
programme.desc: Darcy, a talented event planner returns to her home town to plan her mother's wedding. She's having trouble accepting her stepfather-to-be and quickly Darcy's obsession with perfection begins to clash with her mother's wishes for a low-key celebration —especially when it comes to handsome and charming Kyle, the chef Darcy deems inadequate for catering the event. But as complications arise—both personal and professional—it's Kyle who is able to help her pull off the big day and help her find the love she's been looking for…

programme.title: A Wedding to Remember
programme.desc: On opposite sides of a development project, Olivia and Brian are surprised to find they are the Maid of Honor and Best Man at the same wedding. They have to put their feelings aside to save their best friends' wedding... which may turn out to be their own as well.

programme.title: Arctic Blast
programme.desc: When a solar eclipse sends a colossal blast of super chilled air towards the earth, it then sets off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens to engulf the world in ice and begin a new Ice Age.

programme.title: Jabberwocky
programme.desc: Amid the filth and muck of England in the Dark Ages, a fearsome dragon stalks the land, casting a shadow of terror upon the kingdom of Bruno the Questionable. Who should emerge as the town's only possible saviour but Dennis Cooper (Michael Palin), an endearingly witless bumpkin who stumbles onto the scene and is flung into the role of brave knight.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: A celebrated military contractor returns to the site of his greatest career triumphs and re-connects with a long-ago love while unexpectedly falling for the hard-charging Air Force watchdog assigned to him.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: When a wisecracking black hustler from South Central L.A. finds himself transported back to medieval England, he leads the overthrow of an evil king and wins the heart of a proto feminist woman.

programme.title: The Way Back (2011)
programme.desc: A small band of convicts stage a daring escape from a World War II-era Siberian gulag, and embark on a treacherous journey across five countries in a race for freedom and survival.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: When Traci is a no-show for her first raid, 15 Division fears the gun dealer they're after has kidnapped her.

programme.title: Boo! A Madea Halloween
programme.desc: Madea spends her Halloween fending off killers, ghosts and zombies while keeping an eye on a group of teens.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Boo 2! A Madea Halloween
programme.desc: Madea and friends scare up big laughs on a hell-arious journey to rescue her niece from a haunted campground.

programme.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: A madman intends to kill as many people as possible during Halloween celebrations using strange magical masks.

programme.title: I Know Who Killed Me
programme.desc: An idyllic small town is rocked when Aubrey Fleming (Lindsay Lohan), a bright and promising young college student is abducted and tortured by a sadistic serial killer. When she manages to escape, the traumatised girl who regains consciousness in the hospital insists that her identity is that of Dakota Moss a stripper in a seedy club and that the real Aubrey Fleming is still in mortal danger. A taut and gripping erotic thriller with a captivating riddle at its centre, I Know Who Killed Me explores the dark side of identity, sexuality and obsession.

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: Barbara Thorson (Madison Wolfe) is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants. With the help of her new friend Sophia (Sydney Wade) and her school counsellor (Zoe Saldana), Barbara learns to face her fears and battle the giants that threaten her world.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Fall of a Kingdom
programme.desc: Game of Thrones meets Braveheart. This historical actioner follows a 13th century freedom fighters as they battle for their lives and liberty in the face of the brutal Mongolian Empire. As war breaks out, both sides suffer devastation. Redoubling his efforts, Burunda Khan the Mongolian general - unleashes the full fury of his force. Starring Robert Patrick, Tommy Flanagan and Poppy Drayton.

programme.title: The Beat Beneath my Feet
programme.desc: With a School of Rock-esque vibe, this hilarious coming-of-age tale explores unconventional friendship in the most riotous way. When nerdy teen Tom meets rebellious American rock legend Max (Luke Perry), he knows this is his chance to fulfil his dreams. Tom agrees not to report the 'presumed dead' Max to the authorities...on the basis that he teaches him how to play guitar.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: When NYC money launderer Moe Diamond (Liam Hemsworth - The Hunger Games) wakes up from a car crash, he's left with no memory, millions in stolen cash, and an insane crew of dirty cops hunting him down. With a stranger (Emory Cohen - Lords of Chaos) who says he's his best friend and a fiance he doesn't remember, Moe must race against the clock to discover his own identity and escape his past.

programme.title: Superbob
programme.desc: Superbob is a hilarious and touching new twist on the superhero genre starring legendary British comedian Catherine Tate (The Office). 7 years ago Robert Kenner, a mild mannered postman from Peckham, South London was struck by a meteor which bestowed him with super powers. 6 years later, Bob finally gets a day off from his superhero duties and tries to get a shot at love

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: A divorced father and his eight-year-old son, spend a rather predictable weekend together, but when a valuable toolbox gets stolen, the search for the thieves will turn into a true family bonding.

programme.title: The Man Without a Face
programme.desc: A drama film about a young boy who befriends a disfigured recluse in a small coastal town and helps him overcome his fear of society and confront his past.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

programme.title: The Christmas Contest
programme.desc: (2021) Festive rivalry starring Candace Cameron Bure and John Brotherton. Exes Lara and Ben compete in a charity Christmas contest, but will they be too wrapped up in winning to notice true love?

programme.title: The Christmas Pageant
programme.desc: (2011) Festive romance starring Melissa Gilbert. A temperamental director is forced to direct a Christmas pageant. She finds herself swept up by the magic of Christmas, and an ex-lover.

programme.title: The Christmas CEO
programme.desc: (2021) Yuletide romcom with Marisol Nichols. Play becomes serious business when a toy company CEO gets an offer to merge with a mega toy firm. But is her ex-business partner ready to seal the deal?

programme.title: Charming Christmas
programme.desc: (2015) Holiday romance with Julie Benz. An uptight woman agrees to play Mrs Claus at her family's department store, and finds herself becoming merrier working alongside a charming man playing Santa.

programme.title: Miss Christmas
programme.desc: (2017) Warming romance with Brooke D'Orsay. A Christmas enthusiast puts out a desperate plea to find the perfect tree for her town square - but the tree isn't all she'll be gifted with this season.

programme.title: Love In Wolf Creek
programme.desc: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: The Song To My Heart
programme.desc: After a childhood on the road with her legendary singer-songwriter father, teashop owner BONNIE HIGHSTREET, wants nothing to do with the music business, but when she helps music sensation RYDER JAMISON, develop lyrics for his new solo album, she rekindles her long abandoned dream and falls in love.

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: Celebrated and adored by millions, she was the Queen of people's hearts, yet the bittersweet story of the last man to truly capture hers has never before. In a story that until now has remained untold, Diana introduces a time in the Princess's life that was important in shaping her final years...

programme.title: A Good Woman
programme.desc: The seductive Mrs. Erlynne (Helen Hunt) travels to Amalfi, Italy, hoping to win over married aristocrat Robert Windermere. But when Windermere's innocent wife Meg (Scarlett Johansson) hears of the scandal, she plots an elaborate revenge.

programme.title: Dancing Through Christmas
programme.desc: OLIVIA is picked to run the Christmas recital of The Nutcracker. When a video of Michael practising ballet with Lily goes viral, Olivia sees how much dance really means to the community. Will Olivia be able to save her dance studio with Michael's help?

programme.title: Back To Love
programme.desc: A young widow returns home for the first time in three years to help prepare her sister's wedding. She is forced to confront her past, including the man she never expected to fall for.

programme.title: Autumn Stables
programme.desc: After her husband's death, Autumn sells her ranch to Jake expecting nothing will change, but Jake has ulterior motives with the land and her heart. Starring: Cindy Busby, Kevin McGarry, Alys Crocker

programme.title: Passport to Love
programme.desc: Nicole, a successful travel blogger, meets Kade, a marketing rep for a travel publishing company, and they form the beginnings of a relationship while exploring an island destination. They juggle their work traveling around the world while seeing each other again. Both know there's something special between them, but it will be put to the test when Kade's competitive boss challenges Kade to thwart Nicole's business.

programme.title: Surviving Love
programme.desc: Jessica Miller is thrust into the "real" world when she graduates from college. To conquer this new world, she must discover her faith, open a box of memories and learn the simple secrets of life only a mother can share.

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: Love Surreal
programme.desc: Abby is a promising art student whose long-term relationship with her perfect—but imaginary—boyfriend Sy is going strong, until fellow student Quinn enters the picture. Trapped into tutoring Quinn, Abby begins to fall for this flawed but flesh-and-blood reality. Now Abby must decide if she's ready for a real chance at love—and if she can let go of Sy.

programme.title: The Wrong Cheerleader Coach
programme.desc: The new assistant coach, Devan, offers private cheer lessons with an agenda.

programme.title: The Wrong Bed: Naked Pursuit
programme.desc: Two strangers wake handcuffed in bed, amnesia-stricken.

programme.title: The Wrong Blind Date
programme.desc: Laura's new man from an online blind dating service has a sinister motive.

programme.title: Sarah / Ellen / Sherman and Dee Ann
programme.desc: A heavily pregnant woman is viciously attacked.

programme.title: The Charm of Love
programme.desc: Art historian Maddie searches for the "Lovers Stone" in the Caribbean with the help of a charming hotelier.

programme.title: Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Young divorce lawyer Kelsey finds it safer to keep love out of her life - that is until a stray dog pairs her with Harrison, the local vet.

programme.title: Killer Mom
programme.desc: When a girl's father dies and leaves behind $40 million, her mom plans to seize it by any means necessary.

programme.title: Intimate Stranger
programme.desc: Karen, the beautiful single mother of precious 9-year-old Justin, never really had much luck with love. This all seems to change when she falls for her “Prince Charming”, Dennis, who is both a caring gentleman and a great friend to her son. But her perfect world begins to crumble when she finds a black rose on her doorstep, hears noises in the attic and gets prank calls in the middle of the night. After breaking up with Dennis her life begins to turn upside down and strange things start happening. Questioning her own sanity and left alone by authorities, friends and family, she decides to take matters into her own hands- a dangerous decision that puts her life on the line…

programme.title: Funny Lady
programme.desc: FUNNY LADY resumes several years after FUNNY GIRL and chronicles Fanny Brice's relationship--both personal and professional--with second husband, showman Billy Rose.

programme.title: Julie & Julia

Based on two true stories, Julie & Julia intertwines the lives of two women who, though separated by time and space, are both at loose ends...until they discover that with the right combination of passion, fearlessness and butter, anything is possible.

programme.title: How Do You Know?
programme.desc: Feeling a bit past her prime at 27, former athlete Lisa Jorgenson finds herself in the middle of a love triangle, as a corporate guy in crisis competes with Lisa's current, baseball-playing beau.

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: The perfect world of a beautiful Seattle television reporter is shattered by the prediction of her death in seven days.

programme.title: Before You Know It
programme.desc: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star!

programme.title: Gunsight Ridge
programme.desc: Stage line agent investigates a series of robberies by taking the job of a deputy sheriff in a border Arizona town.

programme.title: Minnesota Clay
programme.desc: In 1883, Clay, a gunfighter with health problems, is wrongfully imprisoned in Drunner Labor Camp. He was framed by Fox, the corrupt sheriff of Mesa Encantada. Fox now extorts the town's people, running a violent protection racket. Clay, determined to clear his name, is approached by bandit Ortiz, who wants him to kill Fox.

programme.title: The Animals
programme.desc: A woman tracks down the three men who raped her, helped by an Apache. Traveling through the Old West to her new home, young schoolteacher Alice McAndrew is abducted by five outlaws headed by robber Pudge Elliott. The thugs rape Alice before leaving her for dead, but she is rescued by Chatto, an Apache chief. He restores her health and aids her in her bloodthirsty quest for revenge. With her sanity wavering, will Alice be able to find the men who tortured her?

programme.title: Dead Aim
programme.desc: A traveling gravedigger during an war adopts a orphan he finds alone in the desert. After the war with the orphan grown and business slow, the orphan begins to generate business himself by shooting people.

programme.title: The Singer Not the Song
programme.desc: Dramatic western about a murderous bandit who terrorises a Mexican village, and the idealistic Irish priest.

programme.title: Miss London Limited
programme.desc: Arthur's business is in a mess. He supplies visiting troops with female escorts.

programme.title: The Divorce of Lady X
programme.desc: Laurence Olivier plays Logan, a divorce lawyer, stranded in overcrowded hotel.

programme.title: A Window in London
programme.desc: A man who witnesses a murder through the windows of a passing train tries to track down the killer.

programme.title: Memories of Montmartre
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Paris, France to find a stolen locket, so they can clear Sydney's dead grandmother of the charges.

programme.title: The Put Back
programme.desc: Kuba, Africa 100 AD: Worshippers of Woote curse his idol to protect it. 2000: Ross Crawford comes to Sydney, because he took the idol and the curse has accelerated his aging.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel set out to find if the legend of the lost civilization in New Guinea is actually true. Unfortunately, they have to team up with Derek Lloyd.

programme.title: Dagger of Death
programme.desc: India, 500 A.D.: A precious dagger is used in human sacrifices to goddess Kali. Sydney must return a relic to India for her fellow hunter, who believes the dagger made him kill his assistant.

programme.title: Last of the Mochicas
programme.desc: On a search for a South American Mochica Indian relic of protection, Nigel and his colleagues get captured by local guerrillas. It's up to Sydney and ally Jason Clark to save them.

programme.title: Fertile Ground
programme.desc: Sydney reunites with her high school sweetheart to track down a Hawaiian fertility idol in Madagascar.

programme.title: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney receives a deck of rare Tarot cards from her recently deceased friend. The infamous, previously unmentioned Vulture was after him. Sydney enlists Claudia to help.

programme.title: Three Rivers to Cross
programme.desc: According to local monks, the Famed Jade Empress is hidden in the valley that will be flooded when the Three Rivers Dam's flood gates have their grand opening.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Two immortally linked souls transcend the boundaries of time and space, one desperately searching for the answers that will save the other, and deliver the promise of eternal life.

programme.title: All the Names of God
programme.desc: The gripping story of an unsuspecting taxi driver who becomes a pawn in a dangerous game of survival as he is taken hostage after a terrorist attack.

programme.title: Adrift

The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back
programme.desc: The violent impulses of Bob Malone (Michael Rooker), a former Los Angeles policeman forced to leave his job in disgrace, get the better of him during a bank robbery, and he wipes out nearly all the robbers. Meanwhile, Koji (Ryo Ishibashi), a Yakuza killer in town to meet with the local Mafia, turns the tables on a deranged terrorist who threatens to bomb an eatery. Corrupt cops bring Koji in, but he soon escapes from custody -- taking Malone and his daughter, Chelsea (Danielle Harris), hostage.

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted an exciting line-up of both new and older jazz groups. Opening things up is the British trombonist Charlie Galbraith's All Star Jazz Band, performing classic Dixieland jazz. Next up is German singer Knut Kiesewetter, who, with backing from the Prague Dixieland Band, sings the blues. Perhaps the highlight of this event is the coupling of American alto saxophonist Bud Shank with Dutch pianist Pim Jacobs' trio, who play standards and bossa nova. Bringing things to a close are French clarinetist Marc Laferrière and his New Orleans Stompers with more classic Dixieland.

programme.title: Christian Scott
programme.sub-title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, The Walk
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Tord Gustavsen, Bugge Wesseltoft & Jaga Jazzist
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world's metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage'. In this episode, Oslo serves as a backdrop for sets by pianists Tord Gustavsen and Bugge Wesseltoft, as well as Jaga Jazzist collective.

programme.title: Christian Scott
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Paul Desmond, Dave Brubeck & Joe Morello
programme.sub-title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history. Captured at the pinnacle of their power and popularity, Paul Desmond (alto sax), Joe Morello (drums), Eugene Wright (bass) and Dave Brubeck (piano) explore the trails they blazed into the realm of odd time signatures with ‘Forty Days' and two versions of their groundbreaking hit ‘Take Five', as well as forays into world music with a unique exploration of ‘Koto Song'. Their intimate onstage chemistry and impeccable musicianship made the DBQ an award-winning jazz supergroup.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Dhafer Youssef
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2018, Tunisian composer Dhafer Youssef alternated between his hypnotic voice and masterful oud playing at Jazz à Vienne. His stunning abilities have to be heard to be believed. He is joined by bassist Matt Brewer and drummer Aaron Parks.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg's Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his' Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No. 2, written by 16-year-old Mozart, with Variations for Orchestra, by the mature Schoenberg.

programme.title: Daniel Harding & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.sub-title: Brahms Tragic Overture & Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms's Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan'. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. Mahler completed his first symphony eight years later, in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine' some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: “Sum Of The Parts” is the official authorised story of Genesis made with the full co-operation of the band members. programme.desc: La historia gira en torno a Michelle Madden, oficial de la inteligencia militar británica encargada de manejar un vehículo aéreo no tripulado en una operación secreta, con la intención de capturar a un grupo terrorista en Nairobi.

programme.title: El caso Sloane
programme.desc: Maquiavélica película en clave de thriller político tenso y locuaz que recuerda a los mejores guiones de Aaron Sorkin ('El ala oeste de la casa blanca'). Una implacable y ambiciosa activista luchará contra un poderoso lobby en un intento de cambiar la legislación sobre el control y venta de armas.

programme.title: Deseando amar
programme.desc: Dos vecinos forman un fuerte vínculo después de que ambos sospechen de actividades extramatrimoniales de sus cónyuges. Sin embargo, acuerdan mantener su vínculo platónico para no cometer errores similares.

programme.title: El escritor
programme.desc: Oso de Plata al Mejor Director en el Festival de Berlín 2010. Roman Polanski dirige un apasionado thriller político cargado de suspense en un mundo en el que nada es lo que parece.

programme.title: El Benefactor
programme.desc: La historia de un nostálgico filántropo (Richard Gere) que se involucra y se hace hueco en la vida de un matrimonio recién casado, Olivia (Dakota Fanning) y Luke (Theo James), buscando con ello recuperar experiencias vitales que antaño tuvo.

programme.title: La casa de la esperanza
programme.desc: Una historia conmovedora basada en el hecho real más curioso de la II GM. El director del zoo de Varsovia y su esposa (Jessica Chastain), ayudaron a salvar a cientos de personas (y también a muchos animales del Zoo) de los nazis tras la invasión de Polonia por las tropas alemanas en 1939.

programme.title: Trust
programme.desc: Will Cameron y Lynn han criado a tres hijos despiertos e inteligentes, y todos tenían la sensación de que, una vez las puertas estaban cerradas y la alarma puesta, nada podía pasarles. Pero Annie, su hija de 14 años, empieza una relación on-line con un chicoy rápidamente se gana su confianza

programme.title: Fremont
programme.desc: Comedia dramática con una historia llena humanidad y optimismo. Donya es una ex traductora afgana del gobierno de Estados Unidos que ahora vive sola en Fremont, California.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Perdido en Florencia
programme.desc: Eric Lombard es un americano con el corazón roto en una fase de su vida en la que tras tomar varias decisiones, decide viajar a Florencia. Allí tratará de descifrar que es lo que más desea, si seguir jugando al fútbol y continuar con su antiguo amor o darle un cambio de rumbo a su vida.

programme.title: El sueño de una noche de verano
programme.desc: Enamórate. Diviértete. Comienza una noche mágica... Un reparto estelar en una maravillosa comedia llena de descabelladas pasiones, peligrosas pociones y espíritus traviesos.

programme.title: De vuelta a casa
programme.desc: Alice (Reese Witherspoon) es una mujer recién separada que decide enfrentarse a nuevos retos y vuelve a Los Ángeles para construirse una nueva vida. Un nuevo trabajo que no es exactamente lo que ella esperaba, un colegio nuevo para sus hijos y facturas que pagar.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Un joven licenciado de origen humilde se convierte en secretario y persona de confianza de un acaudalado empresario, quien dirige su propia fábrica de acero. A medida que su relación laboral se estrecha, el joven deberá acudir al domicilio del empresario, donde conocerá a su preciosa joven mujer.

programme.title: Un enredo para dos
programme.desc: El agente de la CIA Miles Kendig, cansado de la incompetencia de sus colegas, decide retirarse y, para que lo dejen tranquilo, amenaza con publicar sus memorias y enviarlas a las agencias de inteligencia de todo el mundo. Como la CIA hace caso omiso de su advertencia, Kendig empieza a escribir y a publicar un capítulo tras otro. Cuando la CIA se da cuenta de que esto supone una amenaza para sus operaciones, decide acabar con el plan de Kendig a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Etiquetado como un marginado por su inteligente familia, un joven con poca capacidad intelectual superará todos los pronósticos…

programme.title: Paul McCartney Get Back
programme.desc: El último trabajo cinematográfico del director británico Richard Lester es este documental en el que se recogen numerosas actuaciones musicales de la banda de Paul McCartney durante una gira mundial del legendario miembro de The Beatles. La película, en la que interviene la mujer del cantante Linda McCartney, contiene, además, material de archivo, fotografías y entrevistas.

programme.title: Eugénie Grandet
programme.desc: Félix Grandet reina en su modesto hogar en Saumur, donde su esposa y su hija Eugénie llevan una existencia libre de distracciones. Extraordinariamente tacaño, no ve con buenos ojos a los guapos pretendientes que se apresuran a pedir la mano de su hija.

programme.title: El extraordinario viaje de T.S. Spivet
programme.desc: T. S. Spivet es un genio de doce años que vive en un rancho en Montana con su peculiar familia. Su gran talento para la cartografía pronto tiene recompensa. Una institución científica le concede un prestigioso premio y, armado con una pequeña maleta, se dispone a cruzar el país para recogerlo.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos cambian cuando el profesor de filosofía es confundido un traficante de drogas.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: La noche del viernes es casi como una noche de Año Nuevo acortada. Uno puede esperar todo tipo de sorpresas esa noche. La noche del viernes tiene su magia especial.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Cuando Theresa trae a su prometido, Simon Green, a casa para el 25.º aniversario de boda de sus padres, se olvida de mencionar un pequeño detalle: es blanco. Decidido a romper el compromiso de su hija, Percy Jones demuestra que el padre no siempre sabe lo que hace.

programme.title: Frances Ha
programme.desc: Frances vive en Nueva York, aunque no tiene un apartamento. Es aprendiz en una compañía de danza, aunque no es realmente bailarina. Tiene una mejor amiga llamada Sophie, pero ahora mismo no se hablan. Frances quiere mucho más de lo que tiene, pero disfruta de la vida con alegría y despreocupación.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: En qué piensan los hombres
programme.desc: Cuatro amigos conspiran para revertir la situación con sus mujeres cuando descubren que han estado usando los consejos sobre relaciones de Steve Harvey contra ellos.

programme.title: Rumores Y Mentiras
programme.desc: El guión, obra del dramaturgo Bert V. Royal, es una versión moderna y en clave estudiantil de “La letra escarlata”, la novela de Nathaniel Hawthorne. Narra la historia de una joven que decide fingir que lleva una vida promiscua, creyendo que así obtendrá algún tipo de beneficio. Sin embargo, las circunstancias se volverán en su contra.

programme.title: Peggy Sue se casó
programme.desc: Corre el año 1985. Peggy Sue (Kathleen Turner) es una mujer que está atravesando la dura separación de su marido, Charlie Bodell (Nicolas Cage). Un día recibe una invitación para celebrar junto a sus ex compañeros de instituto los veinticinco años de su graduación escolar. Para ello deciden realizar un baile en el que fuera su instituto. Justo cuando estaban coronando a la Reina de la Noche, la protagonista sufre un mareo y pierde la consciencia. Cuando se despierta percibe que está en el mismo lugar pero que todo está cambiado. Observa que ha vuelto al pasado y que está reviviendo el baile de fin de curso de 1960. Peggy Sue aprovecha la situación para evitar su desgraciado futuro y su infeliz matrimonio junto a Charlie, pero no todo será tan sencillo como piensa, ya que la libertad de los ochenta dista mucho del conservadurismo de los sesenta.

programme.title: Zohan: Licencia Para Peinar
programme.desc: Zohan es un agente de élite del Mossad que guarda un secreto: su sueño es convertirse en peluquero en Estados Unidos. Aprovechando una pelea contra su peor enemigo, un terrorista conocido como ‘El Fantasma', Zohan finge su propia muerte y vuela a Nueva York, armado únicamente con sus tijeras y su secador de pelo.A pesar de su inexperiencia, pronto es contratado por el dueño de una peluquería y consigue atraer a una gran multitud de clientes. Sin embargo, el sueño de Zohan corre peligro cuando su antiguo enemigo le reconoce y planea acabar con él de una vez por todas.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, Los hermanos Dalton se proponen convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Ese sueño se convertiría en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Furia al amanecer
programme.desc: Un agente especial de Chicago es enviado al oeste para traer a los famosos hermanos Reno.

programme.title: Los rastreadores
programme.desc: Cuando la hija de un ranchero es secuestrada por los apaches, forma un grupo y envía a buscar al mariscal de EE.UU., pero en su lugar aparece un mariscal adjunto afroamericano.

programme.title: Los indomables
programme.desc: Un detective de Pinkerton va de incógnito para infiltrarse en una banda de ladrones cuyo jefe es una aguerrida tabernera. Las complicaciones sobrevienen.

programme.title: El gran McLintock
programme.desc: El rico ranchero G.W. McLintock utiliza su poder e influencia en el territorio para mantener la paz entre los agricultores, ganaderos, acaparadores de tierras, indios y funcionarios corruptos del gobierno.

programme.title: Las líneas de Wellington
programme.desc: El romance apasionado, la traición brutal y la nobleza desinteresada tienen como telón de fondo la invasión de Portugal por Napoleón en 1810.

programme.title: El Callejón
programme.desc: Una mujer conoce a un cantante de country mientras espera noticias de su marido desaparecido.

programme.title: Encontrando el amor en San Antonio
programme.desc: Adela Romero, chef de televisión, debe decidir entre aceptar un programa que la llevará por Europa o quedarse en San Antonio tras la fuga de su hija. Allí conoce a un crítico gastronómico local que cambia su perspectiva y le ayuda a redescubrir la ciudad y lo que realmente importa.

programme.title: ¡Al Ritmo!
programme.desc: Cuando su estrella del pop favorita lanza un concurso de baile online, Mia y Mackie crean su propio equipo para competir en el vídeo mientras su némesis y vecina, Avery, utiliza su encanto y sus recursos para sacar ventaja en la competición.

programme.title: Bienvenue à bord
programme.desc: Isabelle, directora de recursos humanos de una gran empresa de cruceros, ha cometido el error de ser la amante de su jefe. Sin embargo, cuando él decide poner fin a la relación, Isabelle se servirá del puesto que ocupa en la compañía para planear su venganza.

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Fahrenheit 11/9 es una mirada polémica y cómica a los tiempos que corren en EE.UU. Michael Moore retrata las elecciones presidenciales de 2016 y estos dos primeros años del mandato de Donald Trump intentando responder las dos preguntas más importantes de la era Trump: “¿Cómo demonios hemos llegado hasta aquí?” y “¿Cómo demonios salimos?”.

programme.title: Todos están muertos
programme.desc: Viendo a Lupe encerrada en casa, en bata y zapatillas, nadie diría que en los 80 fue una estrella del rock. La agorafobia no le permite salir de casa, y su madre, Paquita, se ocupa de ella y de su nieto adolescente. Pero a Paquita se le acaba el tiempo y no quiere marcharse sin recuperar a su hija.

programme.title: ¡Ni te me acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo.

programme.title: María (y los demás)
programme.desc: Desde que murió su madre, María ha cuidado de su padre y de sus hermanos. Responsable y controladora, siempre ha sido el pilar de la familia y se siente orgullosa de ello. Por eso, cuando su padre anuncia que se casa con Cachita, su simpática enfermera, María siente que su mundo se desmorona.

programme.title: La final
programme.desc: Tres amigos hinchas del Atlético Madrid y tres chicas seguidoras del Real Madrid: todos protagonizan una historia de amor la semana de la final de Champions. Aure y Andrea tienen una tensión sexual no resuelta desde la adolescencia, fruto de la casualidad, surge el reencuentro.

programme.title: Atragon
programme.desc: When an ancient underground civilization and their snake-like guardian plots to reclaim the surface world, those of the surface fights back.

Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? This maniacal game pits friend against friend as they try to escape the impossible. Break the chain, lose a life.

programme.title: La odisea de los pioneros
programme.desc: Año 1755. Las colonias inglesas están siendo devastadas por las atrocidades de la guerra. Poderes europeos opuestos entre sí han estallado sobre el valle de Ohio, destruyendo el hogar de familias. Cuando dos hermanas son secuestradas por nativos, luchan por mantener su fe bajo las circunstancias más difíciles.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: After investigating inside a neighbors attic, two high school friends, known for making prank videos, are increasingly plagued by a series of disturbing, supernatural events involving a creepy, vintage doll named Heidi - but no one will take their claims seriously, until it is too late.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio en Los Ángeles y luego uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.title: Batalla de las Ardenas: Guerra de Invierno
programme.desc: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, los alemanes deciden lanzar una última gran ofensiva. Al teniente Robert Cappa y su pelotón se les asigna la responsabilidad de defender un depósito de suministros vital.

programme.title: Los Piratas
programme.desc: Dios Ama el Caviar es la fascinante historia de IOANNIS VARVAKIS y su viaje desde humilde pirata griego hasta convertirse en millonario internacional del caviar, con la confianza de Catalina la Grande de Rusia. Sin embargo, su riqueza y poder no le otorgan satisfacción, y su ambición desmedida solo le trae sufrimiento, hasta que lo entrega todo, incluso a sí mismo, en nombre del amor. Esta epopeya, basada en la vida real de Varvakis, se desarrolla desde la isla griega de Psara hasta la corte de Catalina la Grande en Rusia y las orillas del mar Caspio, para luego regresar a Grecia, un país desgarrado por la guerra civil y la lucha por la independencia durante la Revolución de 1821 contra el Imperio Otomano.

programme.title: AVH: Alien vs. Hunter : NE PAS UTILISER CAR MIRE
programme.desc: Un cazador galáctico persigue a su presa más mortífera del universo.

programme.title: Britannic
programme.desc: Un relato ficticio del hundimiento del H.M.H.S. Britannic frente a la isla griega de Kea en noviembre de 1916. Explora la teoría de un agente alemán saboteando el transatlántico, un barco hospital.

programme.title: Blind man
programme.desc: Comienza con el descubrimiento de un cadáver. Un solitario policía sospecha rápidamente de un hombre ciego, cuya minusvalía le resulta una ventaja. Empieza así una carrera contrarreloj y un duelo a muerte entre dos hombres a cuál más enigmático.

programme.title: Indomable
programme.desc: Estilizado y contundente thriller de acción de Steven Soderbergh. La hermosa Mallory Kane es una joven soldado contratada por numerosos gobiernos para realizar tareas que ellos mismos no podrían llevar a cabo... Se le encomienda una misión donde es traicionada. Ahora sólo planea su venganza.

programme.title: Jackie Chan: Maestro en Kung Fu
programme.desc: Jackie Chan es el invicto Maestro de Kung Fu que reparte acción al estilo tradicional de Jackie Chan. Cuando un joven se dispone a aprender a luchar del mismísimo Maestro, no sólo es testigo de espectaculares combates, sino que aprende importantes lecciones de vida por el camino.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ambientada en los 70', durante la glamourosa y espectacular Edad de Oro de la Fórmula 1, 'Rush' retrata la poderosa historia real de los 2 mayores rivales que el mundo ha conocido: el apuesto playboy inglés James Hunt (Chris Hemsworth), y su metódico y brillante oponente, Niki Lauda (Daniel Brühl).

programme.title: Beowulf & Grendel: El Retorno de la Bestia
programme.desc: El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un troll. Su hijo Grendel jura venganza.

programme.title: El Agente
programme.desc: Thriller en 2030: un mundo en recesión, con graves crisis ambientales por el calentamiento global.

programme.title: El Chicano
programme.desc: El detective Hernández se convierte en “El Chicano” para vengar a su hermano y salvar su ciudad.

programme.title: Tierra Marciana
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos deben averiguar cómo detener la tormenta de arena que se dirige hacia ellos.

programme.title: El último Sharknado Ya era hora
programme.desc: Gil envía a su padre Fin atrás en el tiempo para evitar que empiecen los Sharknados.

programme.title: Una Relación Peligrosa
programme.desc: El delincuente de poca monta Gigli (Ben Affleck) es famoso por sus grandes meteduras de pata. Ricki (Jennifer Lopez) es una gánster con temperamento. Cuando emprenden juntos una misión que se descontrola a lo grande, ¿acabarán resolviendo sus diferencias personales y poniendo remedio a su atracción mutua? Dirigida por Martin Brest (Scent of a Woman), ¡GIGLI es una comedia romántica de alto voltaje que te hará entrar en calor!

programme.title: Los Ángeles de Charlie (2019)
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart, Naomi Scott, y Ella Balinska trabajan para el misterioso Charles Townsend, cuya Agencia de seguridad e investigación se ha expandido internacionalmente. Los nuevos Ángeles son las mujeres más inteligentes, valientes y mejor entrenadas de todo el planeta. Bajo la supervisión de Bosley (Elizabeth Banks), los Ángeles tendrán que proteger una tecnología revolucionaria para evitar que sea convertida en un arma. Además deberán confiar las unas en las otras a medida que sus tareas se vuelven cada vez más peligrosas.

programme.title: El Último Gran Héroe
programme.desc: El joven Danny Madigan vive obsesionado con Jack Slater, el mayor héroe de las películas de acción de la historia, y a menudo sueña con vivir alguna de sus increíbles aventuras. La última de Jack va a ser estrenada y uno de los acomodadores del cine, conocedor de la admiración que el chico siente por su héroe, le regala una entrada para verla. Un ticket que resulta ser mágico y permite al adolescente cruzar la pantalla y protagonizar la película junto a su admirado.

programme.desc: España y Latinoamérica siempre conectadas por la música: no te pierdas las mejores colaboraciones entre artistas de ambos lados del charco.
